?

Size of the image used to find the centerlines. Higher values capture finer details but take longer. Start at 1200 px.

?

How opaque a pixel must be to count as part of the logo. Lower values include faint edges; higher values ignore them. This measures transparency, not color brightness.

?

Removes short side branches from the traced centerline. Increase it to reduce tiny spurs. Too much can remove small details from letters.

IN CONTEXT

See it in the wild

One-color versions turn light shapes, like a white background, into knockouts so the mark still reads.

Paste SVG

In Figma, select your logo, choose Copy as SVG, then paste it here. You can also press Ctrl or Cmd + V anywhere on the page.

WELCOME

Give your logo a little motion.

Drop in an SVG and it draws on, stroke by stroke. Pick a style, tune it if you want, and export an animated SVG.

Drag an SVG here

In Figma, select your logo, choose Copy as SVG, then press Ctrl or Cmd + V.
